assessment.confusion_pair_adequacy: 6 confusion pairs defined with discrimination_key, allowed_cooccurrence, and notes. Strengths: RETREAT/EVADE operationalized threshold; FLANK/BREAKTHROUGH permits co-occurrence; FIRE_SUPPORT always-secondary. Weaknesses: (1) HOLD/FORTIFY discrimination_key conflates area-control with posture; (2) no pair addresses sequential ambiguity resolution; (3) ASSAULT/SEIZE discrimination relies on target type, but terrain vs enemy distinction breaks when the objective IS an enemy-held town.
assessment.hard_negative_quality: 22 intents each have 1 hard_negative pattern. Quality tiered: FEINT→failed ASSAULT (excellent), RETREAT→EVADE (good), FLANK→BREAKTHROUGH (good). Weak: EVADE hard_negative ('obstacle avoidance without enemy threat') is a counterexample, not true hard negative. SEIZE-looking ASSAULT not addressed. Several patterns are descriptive narratives with no computable thresholds. Missing: no hard_negative for BACKGROUND resembling tactical movement.
assessment.feint_definition: FEINT correctly Grade C, requires_plan_tag=true, prohibition against deriving from failed attack. Missing: (1) no multi-echelon feint; (2) no 'feint by negation'; (3) no guidance for feint that accidentally achieves objective. Resolution: add FEINT-override rule for accidental success.
assessment.fire_support_relationship: FIRE_SUPPORT always-secondary constraint is correct. Concern: FIRE_SUPPORT allowed_cooccurrence includes RETREAT — doctrinally this is 'covering force' or 'rearguard action,' not SUPPORT_COORDINATION. Suggest restricting co-occurrence.
assessment.boundary_rule_adequacy: Good: EVADE >5→RETREAT reclassification, FLANK >45° bearing change. Gaps: (1) no minimum duration for BACKGROUND; (2) ASSAULT→SEIZE transition during co-occurrence has no temporal anchor; (3) FIRE_SUPPORT boundary rule ('spans the fire support action(s)') is circular; (4) FEINT boundary rule defers to plan tag with no fallback duration.

recommendations: Add hard_negative for BACKGROUND resembling tactical movement
Specify ASSAULT/SEIZE temporal transition rule when objective contains both enemy and terrain
Convert hard_negative narratives to structured discriminator fields with thresholds
Add minimum_duration for BACKGROUND segments (>=3 steps recommended)
